en.ammaar-muslim: 1. [1/53] Muhammad b. Ismail from al-Fadhl b. Shadhan from Hammad b. Isa from Rib’i b. Abdallah from Abi Basir from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام

in regards the words of Allāh Mighty and Majestic: “they took their rabbis and monks as lords besides Allāh” [9:31] he said: by Allāh – they did not fast for them nor did they pray to them but they (the rabbis and monks) made permissible for them the prohibited and prohibited for them the permissible so they followed them.
